demo.title: affixio-x402.sh
demo.code:
# Before bankr x402 deploy or a paid call, attest the host action
npx -y @affixio/mcp@0.1.0 probe

# Or via SDK in the handler / agent loop
# import { AffixIO } from '@affixio/sdk'
# await affixio.attest({ action: 'bankr.x402.deploy' })

bankr x402 deploy weather

setup: Install AffixIO MCP: `npx -y @affixio/mcp@0.1.0 probe` (or `npm i affixio` / `@affixio/sdk` for scripts)
Attest before `bankr x402 deploy`, `bankr x402 call`, or any paid x402 spend
Fail closed on deny or verify failure — do not send PII or raw keys to AffixIO
